playbookOutputs: SARS income tax reference number issued via CIPC
playbookCommonFailures: All four proposed names rejected as similar to existing names or containing special characters
Certified ID copy older than 3 months, missing the back of the Smart Card, or certification stamp illegible
Proof of residential address not in the director's own name
Director's ID number typed incorrectly so the Home Affairs check fails
Shareholding not confirmed, so share certificates cannot be issued

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID Copy (SA Citizens) or Certified/Apostilled Passport (Foreign Nationals) for Each Director
alternatives: Certified & apostilled foreign passport + valid permit (foreign nationals only)
informationToProvide.helpText: SA citizens must upload a certified SA ID (Smart ID front & back or Green Book), certified within 3 months. Passports are only accepted for foreign nationals.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days. Count them against 'How many directors'.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Residential Address for Each Director (Not Older Than 3 Months)
alternatives: Official bank statement showing physical address
informationToProvide.helpText: Utility bill, municipal account, signed lease, or bank statement dated within 3 months in each director’s name.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of residential address dated within 3 months per director (utility bill, rates/taxes, lease or bank statement) in the director’s own name.

informationToProvide.label: How Many Directors?
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify the total number of initial directors (minimum 1 for a Private Company).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Integer count of directors to cross-check against uploaded IDs and proofs of address.

informationToProvide.label: Director(s) Residential & Postal Address(es)
informationToProvide.helpText: Full street address and postal code for each director.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Residential and postal street addresses with postal codes for all directors.

informationToProvide.label: Director(s) Email Address(es)
informationToProvide.helpText: Active email address for each director (required by CIPC for OTP verification).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid email address for every listed director.

informationToProvide.label: Director(s) Cellphone Number(s)
informationToProvide.helpText: South African mobile number for each director (required by CIPC for SMS OTP verification).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid cell number for every listed director.

informationToProvide.label: Preferred Company Name 1
informationToProvide.helpText: First-choice name. No special characters (!@#%). CIPC automatically appends '(Pty) Ltd'.
informationToProvide.aiHint: First-choice proposed company name without special punctuation.

informationToProvide.label: Preferred Company Name 2
informationToProvide.aiHint: Second-choice proposed company name without special punctuation.

informationToProvide.label: Preferred Company Name 3
informationToProvide.aiHint: Third-choice proposed company name without special punctuation.

informationToProvide.label: Preferred Company Name 4
informationToProvide.aiHint: Fourth-choice proposed company name without special punctuation.

informationToProvide.label: Company Registered Physical Address
informationToProvide.helpText: Physical street address in South Africa (cannot be a PO Box).
informationToProvide.aiHint: South African physical street address and postal code for the company.

informationToProvide.label: Company Postal Address
informationToProvide.helpText: Postal address for official CIPC and SARS correspondence (may be same as physical address).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Postal address and code for the company.

informationToProvide.label: Company Contact Email & Phone Number
informationToProvide.helpText: Official business email address and telephone number.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Company contact email and phone number for CIPC registration.

informationToProvide.label: Company Financial Year-End
informationToProvide.helpText: Default is February (recommended to align with the South African tax year).

informationToProvide.label: Incorporators / Initial Shareholding Split (Names & Percentages)
informationToProvide.helpText: List each incorporator/shareholder and their percentage (must total 100%). Note: Formal Share Certificates can be ordered via our Share Certificate service or Tender Ready Package.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Incorporator names and percentage split totaling 100% for CoR 14.1 / CoR 15.1A.

informationToProvide.label: Do You Want a Free FNB Business Bank Account Referral?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Yes/No preference for FNB business account referral.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect director documents, names and company details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certified ID and proof of address for every director, four names, addresses, contact details, year-end and shareholding received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask for four names in order of preference and explain CIPC tests them for similarity, so good alternatives avoid delays. Remind that Smart Card IDs need front and back certified within 3 months. Ask who the shareholders are and their percentages so share certificates can be issued. Turnaround 1-3 working days after CIPC approves the name; never promise faster.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify director documents and screen names
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass; names, ID numbers, DOB and addresses extracted per director; names screened
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Extract every director's full names, ID number, date of birth, nationality and residential address exactly. Run a CIPC name search for each proposed name and flag close matches and restricted words. Directors must be 18+ and not disqualified — ask if unsure.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft registration handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet with every CoR14.1 / 14.1A field: names in order, directors, incorporators, addresses, contacts, year-end, authorised shares
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Use the CIPC standard short-form MOI (CoR15.1A) with 1,000 authorised no-par-value ordinary shares unless the client asks otherwise. Incorporators = initial shareholders. Nothing guessed — flag gaps.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Reserve name and register the company on CIPC
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Name reservation and registration staged with all fields and certified IDs; Kevin has submitted; tracking number saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CIPC e-Services or BizPortal > Register a company > Private Company. Reserve the four names (CoR9.1), then register with the approved name using the standard MOI. Type ID numbers exactly — CIPC validates against Home Affairs. Upload certified IDs (and proofs of address if asked). ⚠ verify current fees (name reservation ~R50; registration with standard MOI ~R125). BizPortal registrations also return the SARS income tax number automatically. Record the tracking number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC name approval and registration
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, registered MOI and income tax number available
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check tracking status before following up. If all names are rejected, draft a client message with the reasons and ask for four new names, then re-reserve.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft first director resolution (incorporation & bank mandate)
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: First board resolution (adoption of MOI, bank account mandate, financial year-end) drafted with the new registration number
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Draft the first director resolution recording incorporation, registered address, financial year-end, and bank account mandate. Note: Share Certificate is NOT included in standard Private Company Registration (R950) — it belongs to the Tender Ready Package or standalone Share Certificate product.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver CoR14.3, MOI, SARS tax number and first director resolution
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, MOI, SARS income tax number and first director resolution posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain next steps in plain language: open the bank account with the CoR14.3 and MOI, register on SARS eFiling and appoint a tax representative, file the beneficial ownership declaration, and the first annual return falls due 12 months from incorporation. Offer the relevant services (Tax Representative Appointment, BEE affidavit, CSD, Tax Clearance).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
